findings.title: Idempotency guard in replace_once is fragile
findings.message: The guard rejects any text where `new` is a substring. For patch_observer, the replacement text contains the anchor (it ends with the original anchor line), so the anchor still occurs once after patching, and the check relies on `new in text` to catch a re-patch. Because `new` itself is a large multi-line string, repeated application is only caught if the whole block matches exactly. Any whitespace drift in the block lets a second patch slip through and duplicates the phase==3 block.
findings.suggestion: Check for a unique marker such as 'if(phase==3){' or 'foreground_failure' before replacing, and fail if it is already present.
